info.name: Hex & Markdown Viewer
info.summary: Preview binary files as hex and read Markdown files inside Nextcloud
info.description:
# Hex & Markdown Viewer
A lightweight Nextcloud app scaffold for two useful file preview modes.
## Features
- Preview binary files as hexadecimal rows - Show ASCII text next to hex bytes - Read Markdown documents directly in Nextcloud - Minimal installable app structure, ready for GitHub publishing
## Notes
This is a starter app scaffold intended for local installation and further development.
